fieldData.description:
Come share drink & food with your fellow community members and chat about crypto, DeFi, and of course RadixDLT!
This event will be very casual and welcoming. Anyone who wants to make friends and learn about DeFi is welcome. Free food, drinks for everyone.
Reach out to @chiggimps on Telegram for details.
